name: com.unitycoder.ubasic
description: A QBasic-style scripting language for Unity, with a palette-indexed texture as its screen. Bytecode VM, built-in 6x8 bitmap font, SOUND/PLAY audio via pre-rendered AudioClips. Zero reflection and no runtime codegen, so it works under IL2CPP on iOS, consoles and WebGL.

samples.description: Four .ubas programs: a language smoke test, WAIT-driven animation, a playable bat-and-ball game, and a sound/music demo.
